figures.caption: Tē 82 tô.—Pì-jiō-khì ê pō͘-ūi : A, Pak-pō͘-tāi-tōng-me̍h ; V, hā-tāi-chēng-me̍h ; chìⁿ teh chí-bêng huih sūn-khoân ê hong-hiòng. Tùi tāi-tōng-me̍h ū hun tōng-me̍h-chi (aa) khì sīn-chōng ; iā tùi sīn-chōng ū chēng-me̍h (bb) chiap tī hā-tāi-chēng-me̍h. W, su-jiō-kńg ; B, pông-kong ; ‘Pelvic Region’ sī kut-phûn ê pō͘-ūi ; tī chia ê chìⁿ ū chí-bêng jiō teh lâu ê hong-hiòng. (From “The Household Physician,” Blackie and Son, Ltd., publishers.)
